onboarding.title: Ngena
onboarding.intro: Faka imininingwane ye-Xtream Codes yokubhalisile kwakho kwe-IPTV (iseva, igama lomsebenzisi, iphasiwedi), noma uyiyeke igcwaliswe kusuka ku-playlist yakho.
onboarding.connected: Ungenile. Kungeniswa ikhathalogi nomhlahlandlela, kuthatha imizuzwana embalwa…
onboarding.found: Imininingwane ifundwe ku-{source}: yihlole bese ungena.
settings.logoutTitle: Sula ikhathalogi bese ukhohlwa imininingwane yokungena
settings.logoutConfirm: Uphume? Ikhathalogi, umhlahlandlela neziteshi ezisusiwe kuzosulwa, futhi imininingwane yokungena izokhohlwa.
settings.tmdb: Amagama nezifinyezo zamafilimu nochungechunge kuhunyushwa nge-TMDB (themoviedb.org) uma ukuhumusha kukhona, uma kungenjalo kuboniswa okomhlinzeki. Lo mkhiqizo usebenzisa i-API ye-TMDB kodwa awugunyaziwe noma uqinisekiswe yi-TMDB.
settings.manageNote: Susa umaki kulokho ongasafuni ukukubona (Shift + chofoza ukuze kube uchungechunge lonke). Akukho okuphelele: vele uphinde umake, futhi okukhethile kugcinwa uma ikhathalogi ibuyekezwa.
settings.pickGroup: Chofoza iqembu ukuze ubone okuqukethwe yilo, noma uqale ukusesha.
favorites.noneChannels: Azikabikho izintandokazi: khetha isigaba ngenhla bese uchofoza inkanyezi ☆ yeziteshi ofuna ukuzigcina lapha.
favorites.noneMovies: Azikabikho izintandokazi: chofoza inkanyezi ☆ yamafilimu ofuna ukuwagcina lapha.
favorites.noneSeries: Azikabikho izintandokazi: chofoza inkanyezi ☆ yochungechunge ofuna ukulugcina lapha.
playlist.title: Playlist ({count})
sleep.title: Isikhathi sokulala: misa ukudlala ngemuva kwesikhashana
skip.title: Isingeniso nesiphetho sochungechunge
skip.note: Kukhunjulwa kulo lonke uchungechunge. ⏱ ithatha indawo yamanje. Ubude besiphetho bubalwa kusukela ekugcineni kwesiqephu ngasinye, noma ngabe sibude kangakanani.
player.subtitleDelay: Ukubambezela imibhalo engezansi: 0.1 s ngokuchofoza, 1 s nge-Shift (izinkinobho G no-H)
player.subtitleSpeed: Imibhalo engezansi yenzelwe inguqulo yezithombe ezingu-25 ngomzuzwana: yehlise ijubane ukuze ihambisane nale vidiyo (inkinobho J)
player.refused: Umhlinzeki wenqabe lokhu kusakaza (HTTP {code}): isiteshi asitholakali, noma uxhumano selusetshenziswa enye idivayisi.
subtitles.title: Imibhalo engezansi ku-inthanethi
subtitles.none: Ayikho imibhalo engezansi etholakele ngalolu limi.
subtitles.quotaNote: Eluhlaza yiyo enethuba elikhulu lokuhambisana kahle. Ukulanda ngakunye kubalwa emkhawulweni wakho wosuku (5 ngosuku); imibhalo engezansi osuyilandile ihlala itholakala mahhala.

subtitles.remaining.one: Imibhalo engezansi yengeziwe. Kusele ukulanda oku-{count} namuhla.
subtitles.remaining.other: Imibhalo engezansi yengeziwe. Kusele ukulanda oku-{count} namuhla.

error.noResponse: Ayikho impendulo ye-Xtream Codes evela ku-{server}: hlola ikheli leseva
error.importRunning: Ukungenisa kuyaqhubeka, zama futhi emizuzwaneni embalwa
error.subtitlesQuota: Umkhawulo wokulanda wosuku ufinyelelwe, kuzokwenzeka futhi ngo-{time}
error.subtitlesEmpty: Leli fayela lemibhalo engezansi alinalutho noma alifundeki, zama elinye
update.title: Isibuyekezo
update.detail: Qala kabusha manje ukuze uyifake? Uma kungenjalo, izofakwa ngokulandelayo uma i-app ivalwa.
profiles.title: Ama-akhawunti
profiles.note: I-akhawunti ngayinye inezintandokazi zayo, izindawo zokuqhubeka ne-playlist yayo. Umlawuli kuphela ongavula izilungiselelo. Uma kunama-akhawunti amaningi, noma iphasiwedi, i-app ibuza ukuthi ubani obukele uma ivulwa.
profiles.name: Igama
profiles.noteAdmin: Ubona konke futhi angavula izilungiselelo: ikhathalogi, iziteshi namaqembu, ama-akhawunti.
profiles.noteStandard: Ubona yonke ikhathalogi, noma amaqembu akhethiwe kuphela (i-akhawunti yezeMidlalo, ngokwesibonelo). Akakwazi ukuvula izilungiselelo.
profiles.noteChild: Ubona kuphela amaqembu amakwe ngezansi. Akakwazi ukuvula izilungiselelo.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Sula i-akhawunti “{name}”? Izintandokazi zayo, izindawo zokuqhubeka ne-playlist yayo kuzosulwa.
profiles.noCatalog: Ikhathalogi ayikangeniswa: umlawuli kufanele angene kuqala.
error.noProfile: Ayikho i-akhawunti ekhethiwe: qala kabusha i-app
versions.title: Ezinye izinguqulo: ikhwalithi, ulimi
versions.note: Ukukhetha kwakho kuyakhunjulwa: le nguqulo idlala esikhundleni sezinye, futhi izithathela indawo ezintandokazini.
favorites.editTitle: Qamba kabusha noma sula leli khasi lezintandokazi
view.title: Ukubukeka kohlu
view.note: Kuhlukile kuthebhu ngayinye. Isithonjana sokubonisa phezulu kwekholomu sishintsha esethebhu evuliwe.
list.nothingStarted: Akukho okuqhubekayo okwamanje: amafilimu nochungechunge oqala ukukubuka kuzovela lapha.

sort.title: Ukuhleleka kohlu

reminder.title: Isikhumbuzi
backup.title: Isipele
backup.note: Izintandokazi namakhasi azo, izindawo zokuqhubeka, i-playlist, izikhumbuzi nokuthandwayo kwe-akhawunti ngayinye, ama-akhawunti uqobo nezinto ezisusiwe: konke kufayela elilodwa, ukuze uthuthele kwenye i-PC noma uqale kabusha ngemuva kokufaka kabusha. Imininingwane yokungena yokubhalisa ayifakiwe.
backup.confirm: Buyisela isipele sika-{date}? Ama-akhawunti, izintandokazi, izindawo zokuqhubeka nokuthandwayo kwamanje kuzoshintshwa, bese i-app iqala kabusha ekukhetheni i-akhawunti.
error.badBackup: Leli fayela akusona isipele se-app, noma lonakele
profiles.unlockedWarning: I-akhawunti yeNgane ikhona, kodwa i-{names} ivuleka ngaphandle kwephasiwedi futhi ibona konke: ingane ingangena kuyo. Yinike iphasiwedi.
versions.noteSeries: Isiqephu esifanayo siqhubeka ngesikhathi esifanayo kunguqulo ekhethiwe.
